title: 第二十五章 双修！
content_zh:
王大壮说这话的时候，目光落在李玉梅的胸口，又赶紧移开，耳朵根都红了。

    李玉梅的脸颊烧得厉害，红晕从脸颊蔓延到耳根。

    她咬着嘴唇，低着头，沉默了好一会儿。

    气氛有些尴尬，也有些暧昧。

    王大壮正要开口说“要不算了”的时候，李玉梅忽然抬起头，抿着嘴，闭上眼睛说道：“大壮，你按吧，嫂子不介意。”

    王大壮愣了一下，心跳骤然加速。

    他当然知道“不介意”这三个字意味着什么。

    一个守寡五年的女人，让一个年轻男人把手按在自己的胸口上，这不是“不介意”三个字就能解释的。

    可他来不及多想，李玉梅已经闭上眼睛不再说话，长长的睫毛微微颤动着，脸上的红晕在灯光下格外动人。

    王大壮深吸一口气，把右手从她的小腹缓缓上移，按在了她的左胸上。

    掌心触碰到那团柔软的瞬间，两个人的身体同时一颤。

    那种触感让王大壮的大脑瞬间一片空白——柔软，饱满，还带着微微的弹性，像是握着一团温热的棉花，又像是捧着一块融化的丝绸。

    李玉梅的呼吸急促起来，喉咙里溢出了一声轻微的呻吟，那声音又软又糯，带着一种压抑了太久的渴望和释放，像是一根羽毛在王大壮的心尖上轻轻划过，勾得他魂都快飞了。

    他咬了一下舌尖，强迫自己集中精神，催动灵力从掌心释放出去。

    灵气穿透李玉梅的胸腔，将那几条顽固的寄生虫一一绞杀，又在她体内循环了两圈，把残留的有毒物质全部清除干净。

    整个治疗过程其实只需要十几秒钟，正当王大壮要收回手的时候，李玉梅的手忽然抬起来，覆在王大壮的手背上，把他的手按在胸口上，不让他离开。

    “继续摸。”

    王大壮抬起头，看到李玉梅的脸红得像要滴血，正看着自己，眼波流转间，带着一种说不清道不明的情绪——有羞涩，有渴望，有犹豫，也有一种豁出去了的决绝。

    “嫂子……”王大壮的喉咙干涩，声音都有些沙哑。

    李玉梅没有说话，她低下头，双手握住王大壮的手，缓缓地从椅子上站起来，然后牵着他，一步一步地走到床边。

    她坐在床沿上，那双眼睛里倒映着昏黄的灯光和男人的身影，像是一汪深不见底的潭水。
content_en:
When Wang Dazhuang said this, his eyes fell on Li Youmei's chest and quickly moved away, his ears turning red.

Li Youmei's cheeks burned badly, and the blush spread from her cheeks to her ears.

She bit her lip, lowered her head, and was silent for a long time.

The atmosphere was a little awkward and ambiguous.

When Wang Dazhuang was about to say, "Let's forget it," Li Youmei suddenly raised his head, pursed his lips, closed his eyes and said, "Dazhuang, just press it, sister-in-law doesn't mind."

Wang Dazhuang was stunned for a moment, and his heartbeat suddenly accelerated.

Of course he knew what the words "don't mind" meant.

A woman who has been widowed for five years lets a young man put his hand on her chest. This cannot be explained by "don't mind".

But before he had time to think about it, Li Youmei had closed her eyes and stopped talking. Her long eyelashes were trembling slightly, and the blush on her face was particularly moving under the light.

Wang Dazhuang took a deep breath, slowly moved his right hand up from her lower abdomen, and pressed it on her left breast.

The moment their palms touched the soft mass, their bodies trembled at the same time.

That kind of touch made Wang Dazhuang's brain go blank for an instant - soft, full, and slightly elastic, like holding a ball of warm cotton or a piece of melted silk.

Li Youmei's breathing quickened, and a slight moan escaped from her throat. The sound was soft and waxy, carrying a kind of longing and release that had been suppressed for too long. It was like a feather gently scratching the tip of Wang Dazhuang's heart, which made his soul almost fly away.

He bit the tip of his tongue, forced himself to concentrate, and urged the spiritual power to be released from his palms.

The spiritual energy penetrated Li Youmei's chest, strangled the stubborn parasites one by one, and then circulated in her body for two more times, removing all the remaining toxic substances.

The entire treatment process actually only takes more than ten seconds. Just when Wang Dazhuang was about to take back his hand, Li Youmei's hand suddenly raised and covered the back of Wang Dazhuang's hand, pressing his hand on his chest to prevent him from leaving.

"Keep touching."

Wang Dazhuang raised his head and saw Li Youmei's face was as red as blood, looking at him, with an indescribable emotion in his eyes - shyness, desire, hesitation, and a kind of determination to risk everything.

"Sister-in-law..." Wang Dazhuang's throat was dry and his voice was a little hoarse.

Li Youmei did not speak. She lowered her head, held Wang Dazhuang's hand with both hands, stood up from the chair slowly, then led him and walked to the bed step by step.

She sat on the edge of the bed, her eyes reflecting the dim light and the man's figure, like a bottomless pool.
